title: Miss Universe 2026: Why over 15 countries have reportedly withdrawn from the pageant
desc: As many as 17 countries have reportedly withdrawn from Miss Universe 2026 ahead of the November 24 finale in Puerto Rico, citing reasons ranging from franchise disputes and visa restrictions to personal, physical and mental health concerns. Miss Universe Austria Victoria Amerson stepped down to prioritise her mental and physical well-being, while Miss Universe Bulgaria Ana-Maria withdrew following a car accident. Morocco cited financial constraints, while Maldives did not disclose a reason. Six Southeast Asian countries — Thailand, Vietnam, Laos, Singapore, Indonesia and Malaysia — will not participate amid disputes over franchise agreements and licensing rights. Nepal, Angola, Zambia, Zimbabwe, the Republic of the Congo and Saint Martin have also reportedly faced travel or visa-related hurdles, while Saint Martin's representative cited personal reasons. Adding to the controversy, the Miss France Organisation voluntarily withdrew, saying the international pageant's recent direction and controversies surrounding its 2025 edition no longer aligned with its values. Despite their withdrawal, the national titleholders retain their crowns, and Vietnam, which will not compete this year, is set to host the 2027 edition. India will be represented by Miss Universe India 2026 Kaziah Liz Mejo, who was crowned on August 23.
